source.title: Geologic map of Jezero crater and the Nili Planum region, Mars

reference_policy.registration_qualifier: Metadata describes random offsets of about 100-200 m relative to the July 2020 controlled CTX mosaic. This is not a confidence interval or a validated geological tolerance.
reference_policy.requirements_for_future_contact_scoring: Independently check registration to the evaluation imagery, justify geological tolerance for each certainty class, obtain independent authored reference/reviewer evidence, then freeze the evaluation protocol.

contact_semantics.certain: Two units are clearly distinguished at map scale. This does not certify absolute position.
contact_semantics.approximate: A transition is interpreted, but its exact location is obscured or uncertain at map scale.
contact_semantics.inferred: Retain separately if a future source contains it; SIM3464 has no records with this TYPE.
contact_semantics.boundary: Map frame, excluded from geological contact statistics.

reference_policy.crs_conflict: Pamphlet methodology says central meridian 77.3 E, but all acquired vector layers, supplied PRJ and metadata declare 77.5 E. Calculations and exports use the actual 77.5 E vector CRS; no coordinate relabeling or manual shift is applied.

catalogues.title: Known Terrestrial Analog Sites for Planetary Science
catalogues.author: Marc A. Hunter
catalogues.metadata_verification: USGS landing page read through the web tool on 2026-11-14; direct HTTP request returned empty 202.
catalogues.limitation: Catalogue metadata is verified, but point records were unavailable. No spatial match, nonmatch or catalogue absence is asserted. Points would not establish a full published footprint even if available.

refreshed_sources.verification: Acquired and inspected original one-page conference abstract 5041, Mars Extant Life 2019.
refreshed_sources.finding: Anti-Atlas carbonate sequences were explicitly investigated in relation to the Jezero/Midway Mars 2020 targets. This is prior material and biosignature context, not validation of terrain transfer.
refreshed_sources.exact_spatial_overlap: unresolved; abstract supplies regional/transect names without a registered footprint

refreshed_sources.verification: Acquired original 104-page Biosignature Preservation and Detection workshop proceedings; inspected PDF page 68, abstract 2081.
refreshed_sources.finding: Bristol Dry Lake was proposed as an ancient Martian lake analogue using evaporite, brine and nearby basalt observations. The abstract discusses Miyamoto crater as a possible comparison, so it does not establish an exact Bristol/Jezero mapping association.
refreshed_sources.exact_spatial_overlap: unresolved; no registered field footprint was recovered from the abstract

refreshed_sources.verification: Crossref DOI metadata and publisher-registered abstract acquired. Publisher result checked; full article was not newly acquired in this intake.
refreshed_sources.finding: The authored abstract establishes prior Mojave lacustrine-volcanic analogue instrument and geological-unit mapping work. It does not prove overlap with the MIMESIS 20 km footprint.
refreshed_sources.exact_spatial_overlap: unresolved in this intake; no spatial inference from the shared Mojave name

refreshed_sources.verification: Author thesis repository metadata checked; existing acquired thesis and relevant excerpt PDF page 271, printed page 256 inspected.
refreshed_sources.finding: The thesis studies southern Naukluft structure and Northeast Syrtis stratigraphy and compares Northeast Syrtis with Namibian Neoproterozoic reference sections. The historical MIMESIS southern Syrtis target is a different context, so this blocks broad regional originality claims without proving an identical task or footprint.

rules: No unlisted site, different coordinate, changed weight or new rank is novel by default.
Separate prior region, prior target/process association and exact footprint/task overlap.
Regional precedent does not prove exact footprint duplication; unresolved exact overlap does not establish novelty.
Historical v4 leads remain historical. This audit does not reverse their v5 land-mask rejection.
A catalogue point or literature association is not an independent task-performance label.
